## Joseki

This sequence has long been considered an equal result for both players. But critics found it a tad too passive for Black, who already had one stone in the corner and should generally strive for a more advantageous position. (See Haruyama Isamu & Nagahara Yoshiaki, *Basic Techniques of Go*, p. 60.) Nowadays, AI concurs with the original idea that this sequence indeed leads to an equal result for both players.
